notes: Ranger's Guile, printed: 'Target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains hexproof until end of turn. (It can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)' Cast on your bear (3/3, hexproof). Then the opponent's Goblin Arsonist dies; its dies trigger (an ability the OPPONENT controls) cannot target the hexproof bear even when the answer names it, so the 1 damage goes elsewhere and the bear has no damage marked.
